She doesn't look up immediately, instead calculating vectors through the storm. Jora Ward remains braced near the viewport, using the dampeners to stabilize against the kinetic blast, her helmet vents struggling against the superheated vapor.

She doesn't need to run a new query; she pulls up a raw telemetry feed from Jora’s structural sensors on a side monitor, overriding all other alerts. "Timeline projection," she rasps, her voice tight over the shriek. "Gamma-7—the tertiary shunt loop... it won't hold past 90 seconds at this pressure differential."

The timeline shifts from "Gamma-7 failure" to "Systemic Collapse." Helena stares at the monitors, her grim resolve momentarily replaced by sheer operational dread.
